arguments.summary: Credential compromise incident originating from phishing email leading to Cobalt Strike beacon deployment on a high-criticality finance workstation (WS-FIN-042). The attacker leveraged malicious PowerShell execution from Outlook to drop and execute an unsigned DLL via rundll32, establishing C2 communication over HTTPS to a known malicious IP (198.51.100.23). Lateral movement was attempted via SMB to a file server. Immediate containment actions included blocking the C2 IP at the firewall, resetting the compromised user's credentials, and executing a remediation playbook. Full host scan detected additional exploit artifacts. IOCs were shared with ISACs.

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Dynamic_DNS {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Cobalt Strike beaconing behavior using dynamic DNS domain patterns"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1071/004/"
        date = "2026-04-11"
        hash = "a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2"

        $beacon_mutex = "Global\\MSCTF.Asm.{b1e5}" fullword ascii
        $beacon_regkey = "HKCU\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run\\SysUpdate" fullword ascii
        $dns_fallback = /c2\.update-service\.[a-z]{3}/ nocase
    condition:
        any of them
}
